finding: A terminal run could be marked acknowledged before its terminal event was durably committed.
fix: Set terminalSeen only after the terminal journal commit succeeds; leave the effect unknown on commit failure.
verification: application.test.ts terminal journal failure test passes; compile and unit suite pass.

finding: Post-commit maintenance or key-cleanup errors could be reported as failed even though external durable state had committed.
fix: Track mutationCommitted and report unknown after commit; reconcile lifecycle rows on startup.
verification: Code path inspected and compiled; native production execution remains blocked by the absent pinned binding.

finding: Provider-supplied diagnostics and external references could have been persisted without bounded secret/control-character handling.
fix: Bound and sanitize diagnostic text and external references before durable effect or run events.
verification: coordination.test.ts provider-diagnostic test passes; unit suite passes.

finding: The domain effect record did not retain the exact effect kind and canonical request digest.
fix: Add effectKind and requestDigest to the domain record and map run requests to the exact effect intent.
verification: Strict compilation, coordination tests, and reducer tests pass.

finding: Credential-bearing references and secret-designated automation answer keys could enter durable state.
fix: Reject credential URL userinfo/query markers, secret-bearing public references, and secret answer keys at invariant boundaries.

finding: The public storage port exposed obsolete local ID brands instead of the canonical domain IDs.
fix: Re-export every domain ID from domain/ids.ts and keep credential-facility references on a separate brand.
verification: Strict compilation and the full unit scope pass.
